backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend for a home-services app, with data types and CRUD operations for Bookings and Reviews stored in Maps, including filtering by service/rating and featured review retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the TrustFix logo replacement feature was implemented in Footer.tsx and Navbar.tsx, replacing all old logo references with the new postimg URL.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key changes of every component and page in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, sidebar, charts) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the TrustFix React SPA with cache-control meta tags, Google site verification, and a root div that mounts the Vite/React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for Home, Services (with optional category search param), legacy service detail, Booking, Contact, and Reviews, all wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormPopup: Modal popup component with a validated booking form that collects customer details, property type, and scheduling info, then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message on submission.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: Animated service card for cleaning services that displays an image, price badge, features, and Book Now/WhatsApp buttons, with intersection-observer-based fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Auto-advancing carousel component that fetches and displays featured customer reviews from the backend, with navigation controls and star ratings.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed floating button on the bottom-left that opens a WhatsApp chat link when clicked.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button on the bottom-right with a pulse animation and notification dot that opens a WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying brand info, address, contact links, social icons, service category links, and quick navigation links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner section with a background image, headline, and two CTA buttons that open WhatsApp with pre-filled booking or call messages.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that composes Navbar, Footer, and FloatingWhatsAppButton around page content, and scrolls to top on route change.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with desktop/mobile menus, a service search dropdown, and a WhatsApp call button.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: Animated card component for painting services displaying image, price, features, and buttons to book via WhatsApp or request a free inspection.
A card component for displaying pest control services with an image, price badge, features list, and WhatsApp/Book Now action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a customer review with avatar initials, star rating, service label, date, and review text.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: An animated service card with intersection observer visibility, showing an image, price, features, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons.
A carousel component that displays service categories as clickable cards with fallback image handling, navigating to the services page with a category filter on click.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: A grid of service category cards with scroll-triggered fade-in animations, fallback images, and navigation to the filtered services page on click.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Renders a row of star icons for a given rating, supporting optional interactive mode with a click callback.
An animated card for individual service subcategories showing image, price, features, and Get Quote/Book Now buttons with WhatsApp integration.
A form component that allows users to submit reviews with name, service type, star rating, and review text, using a mutation to call the backend actor and invalidating review queries on success.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for all service categories (pest control, cleaning, painting, etc.) along with contact/WhatsApp utility functions and subcategory/package details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
Custom hook that exposes a mutation for submitting a booking to the backend actor and then opening a pre-filled WhatsApp message on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports three React Query hooks (useGetFeaturedReviews, useGetAllReviews, useGetAllBookings) that fetch data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Custom hook that filters and returns up to 8 deduplicated service search results matching a query string against category and service names/descriptions.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins/Inter fonts, configures Tailwind with CSS custom properties for theming (light/dark), and defines component styles and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: A booking form page that collects user details (name, phone, address, service, property type, date, time) and submits them as a pre-filled WhatsApp message to the TrustFix team.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact page displaying TrustFix's phone, WhatsApp, address, email, and working hours as clickable cards with links.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The main landing page composing HeroSection, trust badges, service carousel, 'Why Choose Us' features, featured reviews, and a WhatsApp CTA banner.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: A reviews page that fetches all reviews from the backend actor via React Query and displays them in a grid alongside a WriteReviewForm component.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: A services listing page with category-based filtering, painting package cards, subcategory cards, and a booking form popup, pulling data from the services data module.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom brand colors, fonts (Inter/Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and animations like fadeInUp and wave.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for TrustFix tracking version, architectural notes, and completed feature to replace all logo instances site-wide with a specific hosted image URL.
